name: Always Gray
source:
Always Gray is a +18 semi-linear visual novel about four friends dealing with problems in their lifes.

Adam, a young adult red fox, starts to rethink his life decisions and regrets how divided he became from his family. Now only himself can make amends and reconnect with the people he cares so much. He won't be making such life-changing decision alone. Samanta and Harry, his best friends, will help him go through anything. While seeking for a better relationship with his family, Adam can achieve something more romantic with someone that got his back for a lot of time, or go out with the new neighbour, George, and see what happens.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220807215830/https://eviejr.itch.io/always-gray]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Always Gray》是一部面向18岁以上玩家、以线性叙事为主的视觉小说，讲述四位朋友面对各自生活难题的故事。

年轻成年的红狐亚当开始反思自己的人生选择，也为与家人日益疏远而后悔。如今，只有他自己能弥补过错，重新与那些深爱的人建立联系。所幸，在做出这些足以改变人生的决定时，他并不孤单。最好的朋友萨曼塔和哈里会帮助他渡过一切难关。在努力改善与家人关系的同时，亚当也可能与一位长期支持自己的人发展出恋情，或者与新邻居乔治约会，看看会发生什么。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220807215830/https://eviejr.itch.io/always-gray]itch.io[/url]]
